messages.author: wangjianing_mail
messages.body:
Dear Amber user:
Here is a error when i want to orca in amber QM/MM, it will open a orca Screen Reader and print SANDER BOMB in amber out file.
This may mean that amber called another Orca software incorrectly?
It's available to "orca orc_job.inp > out", where orc_job.inp is generated from the operation of sander.
I don't know how to solve this problem for there is anothor orca screen reader in / usr / bin without root
#bashrc
PATH=$PATH:/..../orcafolder
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$ LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/.../orcafolder
alisa orca='/.../orcafolder/orca'
#command
sander -O -i -p -c -r -x -y
#software
amber18
orca4012_linux_x86-64
Regards,
Jia-Ning Wang

messages.author: James Kress
messages.body:
This is wrong:
